PARTNERSHIP ROUTES

Four ways to work with us.

Each pathway has defined requirements, evaluation criteria and engagement protocols. We value capability and alignment over speed.

Suppliers & contractors

Equipment, maintenance, logistics, safety and site services. All supplier engagements are subject to formal qualification requirements, competitive evaluation and no promise of award. We seek reliable partners who can deliver in challenging environments.

Technical partners

Geology, mine planning, mineral processing, environmental management, safety systems and financial reporting expertise. We need professionals who bring rigorous methodology and are comfortable with staged, evidence-based decision-making.

Institutions

Government bodies, universities, training providers, development institutions and community organisations. We welcome structured collaboration that builds local capability and supports the broader development context in which we operate.

Mining investors

Partners aligned with staged verification, professional management and long-term value creation. This is not a quick-return opportunity — it is a partnership for patient, experienced mining investors.

PARTNERSHIPS / BUILDING TOGETHER
OUR STANDARDS

What we expect from partners.

Perpach operates in a sector where trust is earned slowly and lost quickly. We apply the same rigour to selecting partners as we do to evaluating mining opportunities. Every potential partner goes through a structured assessment process.

We look for demonstrated capability in relevant mining or technical disciplines, alignment with our staged development approach, financial stability, and a track record of ethical business conduct. References are checked. Claims are verified.

In return, we commit to transparent communication, fair commercial terms, clear scope definitions and professional engagement throughout the relationship.

START A CONVERSATION

Partnership inquiry.

Tell us about your organisation and how you believe we can work together. All inquiries are reviewed by the appropriate team and responded to within five business days.

Important: Perpach never requests fees, deposits or financial commitments as a condition of partnership discussions. Trust only correspondence from an approved @perpach.com address.

Please do not submit identity documents, banking details, confidential technical data, or investment funds.
